_doc: PENDING S4 payload-semantic conformance vectors — NOT YET WIRED. These describe the PER-OPCODE PAYLOAD vectors the S4 stories (F-05 RUN{mode:source}, F-06 STOP + SOFT_REBOOT, F-07 console tee + stdin, F-23 cap-gated IDENTIFY) will pin in the SHARED cross-language corpus (corpus.json), byte-identical for the firmware pble_* codec and the Dart pble client. They carry NO frame_hex ON PURPOSE: the byte encodings they depend on live in protocol.md §6 (Run/Stop/Console) and §7/§4 (IDENTIFY / OI-6 remainder), which are STILL DRAFT (freeze ledger, 2026-07-01: §6 STOP/CONSOLE_INPUT/RUN{mode:source} 'freeze at S4'; §7/§4 SET_IDENTIFY_LED + IDENTIFY encodings are the OI-6 REMAINDER, 'frozen at S4 before F-23'). Fabricating frame bytes here would REDEFINE draft wire — forbidden (wire is referenced, never redefined). Each entry states the frozen SEMANTIC obligation and the EXACT freeze it is BLOCKED on. When protocol.md §6/§4/§7 + the specs.md FR mirror + the specs.md OI-6 close land, firmware-test-author fills in field tuples + zlib-oracle frame_hex and promotes these into corpus.json. This is the S2->S3->S4 pattern: see s3_pending.json.

_meta.frozen_inputs: protocol.md §3.1 frame (G0), §4 opcode SET+numbers (G1 2026-07-01, closes OI-4), §8 status SET+numbers (G1 2026-07-01), §6 RUN-file lifecycle + single-program EBUSY (G1 2026-07-01)
_meta.draft_blocking_s4: protocol.md §6 STOP/SOFT_REBOOT/RUN{mode:source}/CONSOLE_DATA/CONSOLE_INPUT PAYLOAD+semantics; protocol.md §4/§7 OI-6 remainder (SET_IDENTIFY_LED GPIO+active-level encoding, IDENTIFY blink-duration bound, has_identify/identify_led caps serialization)

_blocked_on.protocol.md_§6_run_source: RUN{mode:source} payload shape (the [mode][data] discriminator: file vs inline snippet); the RSP-then-RUN_STATE(running)->done/error sequence for a source run MUST be identical to the frozen file-run lifecycle
_blocked_on.protocol.md_§6_stop: STOP payload (none) + semantics: RSP{OK} ALWAYS (idempotent — STOP while idle is a no-op OK); if running, interrupt -> clean teardown -> RUN_STATE(idle); RSP returns immediately (link stays live)
_blocked_on.protocol.md_§6_soft_reboot: SOFT_REBOOT payload (none) + semantics: RSP{OK} immediately; VM soft-reset; terminal -> RUN_STATE(idle); BLE link kept where possible
_blocked_on.protocol.md_§6_console_data: CONSOLE_DATA payload framing: [stream:u8][bytes], stream 0=stdout / 1=stderr; observe-anywhere (streamed regardless of which client triggered the run)
_blocked_on.protocol.md_§6_console_input: CONSOLE_INPUT payload [bytes] + the NO-RSP (fire-and-forget) rule: the dispatch path MUST emit NO reply frame for CONSOLE_INPUT (the PBLE_NO_RSP internal sentinel is never transmitted)
_blocked_on.protocol.md_§4_§7_identify_oi6: OI-6 REMAINDER: SET_IDENTIFY_LED payload ([gpio:u8][active_level:u8]; empty len 0 clears) + validation (ERANGE gpio out of range, EBADREQ active_level not in {0,1}); IDENTIFY payload (optional [duration_ds] bound) + EUNSUPPORTED-when-unset; has_identify/identify_led additive caps serialization in §7
_blocked_on.specs.md_OI6_close: the specs.md §5 OI-6 remainder is still OPEN; the firmware-architect closes it (FR-IDENT-2/3/4) in its own [docs] commit AFTER protocol.md §4/§7 freeze — no F-23 payload [red] before that

_frozen_frame_level_already_in_corpus: corpus.json ALREADY carries the FRAME-LEVEL (opaque-payload) S4 vectors whose opcode is §4-frozen and whose RSP payload[0] is a §8-frozen status: run_cmd_source_opaque_250b (0x20), run_rsp_ok / run_rsp_ebusy (0x20), stop_rsp_ebusy (0x21), run_state_evt_running (0x40), console_data_evt (0x30), identify_rsp_eunsupported (0x52). Those guard the FRAME CODEC + CRC + fragmentation only; the PAYLOAD-SEMANTIC vectors below are what freeze at S4.

pending_vectors.name: run_source_lifecycle
pending_vectors.obligation: RUN{mode:source,<inline snippet>} MUST execute the snippet with the SAME lifecycle as a file run: RSP{OK} -> RUN_STATE(running) -> normal end RUN_STATE(done) / uncaught RUN_STATE(error); a bad mode discriminator -> EBADREQ; over-length data -> ERANGE; a RUN issued while running -> EBUSY (FR-RUN-2, FR-RUN-4/7). RUN_STATE byte enum (0 idle/1 running/2 done/3 error) is already frozen (F-04).

pending_vectors.name: stop_idempotent_ok
pending_vectors.obligation: STOP MUST answer RSP{OK} ALWAYS — STOP while IDLE is a no-op OK (idempotent), STOP while RUNNING raises KeyboardInterrupt in the runner and lands promptly -> clean teardown -> RUN_STATE(idle) (FR-RUN-5/6/10). RSP returns immediately from the host task so the BLE link stays live (FR-BLE-11).
pending_vectors.note: STOP-interrupts-while-True-promptly-while-BLE-stays-responsive is HIL-ONLY (gates/g1_s4_check.sh); the payload/RSP framing is the conformance half.

pending_vectors.name: soft_reboot_clears_to_idle
pending_vectors.obligation: SOFT_REBOOT MUST answer RSP{OK} immediately, soft-reset the MicroPython VM, and end terminal at RUN_STATE(idle); a running program is stopped first; the BLE link is kept where possible (FR-RUN-8).
pending_vectors.note: the actual VM clear (globals gone, fresh namespace) is HIL-ONLY.

pending_vectors.name: run_while_running_ebusy
pending_vectors.obligation: a second RUN (file OR source) while a program is running MUST be refused RSP{EBUSY} (single-program rule). This SEMANTIC is §6-frozen (F-04); the frame vector run_rsp_ebusy/stop_rsp_ebusy is already in corpus.json. Included here so the S4 gate re-asserts it against a SOURCE run.

pending_vectors.name: console_data_stream_tag
pending_vectors.obligation: the running program's stdout AND stderr MUST arrive as CONSOLE_DATA EVTs (ID=0) tagged by stream: [stream:u8][bytes], stream 0=stdout / 1=stderr (FR-CON-1/2). Console is observe-anywhere: streamed regardless of which client triggered the run (FR-CON-4).
pending_vectors.note: REPL/main-task UART output MUST NOT be teed to BLE — only the worker's output. HIL-verified.

pending_vectors.name: console_input_no_rsp
pending_vectors.obligation: CONSOLE_INPUT{bytes} feeds a program blocked on input()/sys.stdin (FR-CON-3) and is FIRE-AND-FORGET: the dispatch path MUST emit NO reply frame (the internal PBLE_NO_RSP=0xFE sentinel is NEVER transmitted). A conformance vector asserts dispatch suppresses the RSP for 0x31.
pending_vectors.note: input() round-trip (bytes actually reach the running program) is HIL-ONLY.

pending_vectors.name: console_traceback_on_error
pending_vectors.obligation: an uncaught exception MUST surface as CONSOLE_DATA(stream=stderr, traceback text) FOLLOWED BY RUN_STATE(error) (FR-RUN-9, FR-CON-2). Also: a missing/inaccessible RUN{mode:file} path surfaces ASYNC as CONSOLE_DATA(stderr,traceback)+RUN_STATE(error) — the runner is NOT coupled to the FS jail.

pending_vectors.name: set_identify_led_body_persists
pending_vectors.obligation: SET_IDENTIFY_LED{[gpio:u8][active_level:u8]} MUST validate + persist a SINGLE identify-LED config to NVS (FR-IDENT-2/5); active_level 0=active-low, 1=active-high; an EMPTY payload (len 0) clears/disables it. RSP: OK | ERANGE (gpio outside the chip's valid GPIO range) | EBADREQ (active_level not in {0,1}). Cosmetic device config ONLY — never user-code routing (CON-13, FR-IDENT-6).
pending_vectors.verify: conformance (payload+validation once frozen) + HIL (persist across reboot)

pending_vectors.name: identify_blink_bounded
pending_vectors.obligation: IDENTIFY{optional [duration_ds]} MUST blink the configured LED for a BOUNDED duration and answer RSP{OK} IMMEDIATELY (non-blocking, blink runs on a timer, FR-IDENT-3, FR-BLE-11); duration bound (proposed 1..50 ds, default when absent/0, clamp above max). RSP{EUNSUPPORTED 0x0A} when NO identify LED is configured (FR-IDENT-4). identify_rsp_eunsupported frame vector is already in corpus.json.
pending_vectors.note: non-blocking blink VISIBLE while a run continues + BLE stays responsive is HIL-ONLY.

pending_vectors.name: caps_has_identify_and_identify_led
pending_vectors.obligation: the HELLO RSP caps AND the DEVICE_INFO/INFO-read payload MUST carry has_identify (bool) and identify_led (gpio u8, or null=0xFF when unset), ADDITIVE within PBLE/1 (§9) — an older client ignores them; the app offers Identify only when has_identify is set (FR-INFO-3, §7). Sourced from the same one caps builder that serves HELLO+DEVICE_INFO+INFO.
pending_vectors.note: extends the S3 hello_rsp_caps_complete pending vector (s3_pending.json), also blocked on §7 caps serialization.

pending_vectors.name: identity_identify_console_run_never_gate_access
pending_vectors.obligation: the agent MUST NOT gate access on MAC / device_id / label; RUN, STOP, CONSOLE_INPUT, SET_IDENTIFY_LED and IDENTIFY MUST behave IDENTICALLY whether or not a label / identify LED is configured; the IDENTIFY blink is COSMETIC and maps NO hardware for user code (SEC-11, CON-13, FR-IDENT-6). This is a structural/HIL invariant, not a byte vector — the gate re-asserts it every slice.
